{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_patients}')

# Check how many rows have biomarker_baseline == -999
missing_baseline = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {missing_baseline}')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient
sample_seq_max = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq (retested): {len(sample_seq_max[sample_seq_max > 1])}')"}
